home.hero_tag: The premium service you and your vehicle deserve. Here, we care not only for cars, but for people.

services.hero_tag: We've elevated automotive maintenance to a state-of-the-art level.
services.service_1_desc: Repairs carried out with precision and advanced technology, even on vehicles with high-impact damage. Santorini operates with alignment and millimetre-precision measuring equipment, ensuring each vehicle regains its original geometry, safety and factory-standard finish.
services.service_2_desc: Service focused on the visual restoration and preservation of the vehicle, including polishing and detailed cleaning, ensuring a high-standard finish and immediate enhancement of the vehicle's value.
services.service_3_desc: Automotive painting using advanced technology and precision to achieve a factory-standard finish, with uniform colour, intense gloss and impeccable results in every detail.
services.service_4_desc: Fast and precise solutions to eliminate scratches and minor imperfections, delivering a factory-standard, premium finish.
services.service_5_desc: Comprehensive automotive mechanical service, including diagnostics, preventive and corrective maintenance, with a focus on safety, performance and vehicle durability.
services.service_6_desc: Complete vehicle inspection to identify issues before they develop into faults, increasing safety, reducing future costs and extending the vehicle's lifespan.
services.service_7_desc: Provision of automotive electrical services, including electronic diagnostics, repair and replacement of electrical components, ensuring the performance and safety of vehicle systems.
services.service_8_desc: Automotive electronic diagnostic service carried out with appropriate scanning equipment for reading, interpreting and clearing fault codes, ensuring accurate and efficient diagnostics.
services.service_9_desc: Provision of automotive suspension services, including diagnostics, inspection and replacement of shock absorbers, springs and associated components, ensuring correct vehicle handling on the road.
services.service_10_desc: Provision of braking system services, including inspection, repair and replacement of pads, discs and associated components, ensuring proper operation and vehicle safety.
services.service_11_desc: Provision of oil and filter change services, including engine oil and replacement of recommended filters, in accordance with manufacturer specifications.
services.service_12_desc: Provision of vehicle servicing, including general inspection, oil and filter replacement, and checking of key mechanical and electronic systems.
services.cta_text: Our team of specialists is ready to provide the best care for your vehicle.

about.history_p1: Santorini was founded in the heart of Leiria with a clear vision: to transform the automotive service experience into something simpler, more transparent, and more reliable for everyone. From the very beginning, we believed that repairing a vehicle is only part of our work.
about.history_p2: Our true commitment lies in providing peace of mind, safety, and confidence to every customer who entrusts us with their vehicle. With over 15 years of experience in the automotive sector, Santorini has built a solid reputation based on professionalism, technical precision, and absolute dedication to quality.
about.history_p3: Over the years, we have become a benchmark in bodywork and paint, recognised for the excellence of our finishes and attention to every detail. Our company has been strategically structured to offer a complete, efficient, and accessible service, capable of meeting both the demands of private customers and the needs of corporate fleets.
about.history_p4: We continuously invest in knowledge, processes, and service quality, because we believe every vehicle deserves the highest standard of care. But what truly defines Santorini goes beyond technique and experience. It is the relationship of trust we build with every customer. Here, each person is welcomed with respect, closeness, and commitment.
about.history_p5: Every vehicle is treated with the care it deserves. Because we know that behind every car, there is a story, a routine, and a life that needs to go on. At Santorini, we do more than repair vehicles — we build trust every day.
about.cta_text: Our team of specialists is ready to provide the best care for your vehicle.
